controlSurfaceActuator.alt: Section of a wing with a flap and the actuator that drives it, drawn from its attachment on the wing at parentXsi 0.66 and parentHeight 0.45 to its attachment on the flap at parentXsi 0.3 and parentHeight 0.5

controlSurfaceTrackTypes.alt: The four track types in the section of a wing with a flap: (a) trackType1, a revolute joint P1 on the hinge line; (b) trackType2, a dropped hinge P2 below the wing carried by strut1 from P1, with strut2 to the flap at P3 and P4; (c) trackType3, a forward link strut1 from P2 to P3 on the flap and a carriage running on the straight track from P5 to P6 that carries the flap at P4; (d) trackType4, like trackType3 with the track from P7 to P8 and an upright link strut3 from P5 on the flap to P6 on the fixed structure

controlSurfaceCutOutPlanform.alt: Top view of a wing with a flap at the trailing edge and a slat at the leading edge and the cut-outs they need in the wing: the flap cut-out reaches further forward than the flap and ends at its borders, the slat cut-out reaches further aft than the slat and has its own borders at etaLE 0.43 and 0.92

controlSurfaceCutOutSections.alt: Sections at the inner borders of two control surfaces with the part of the wing that their cut-out removes: (a) a flap whose cut-out is cut straight between the upper skin at xsiInnerBorder 0.68 and the lower skin at 0.64, ahead of the leading edge of the flap; (b) a slat whose cut-out runs from the upper skin at xsiInnerBorder 0.17 through the control point at xsi 0.06 and relHeight 0.45 to the lower skin at 0.14, so that the wing keeps a nose inside the hollow rear side of the slat

controlSurfacePath.alt: Section of a wing at the inner border of a flap: the hinge point at hingeXsi 0.75 and hingeRelHeight 0.2 on the line between lower and upper surface, and the flap at control parameter 0 (undeflected), 0.5 (rotated by 10 degrees, hinge points moved 0.2 m back and 0.05 m down) and 1 (30 degrees, 0.5 m back, 0.15 m down)

controlSurfacePlanform.alt: Top view of a wing with a flap at the trailing edge inboard of the kink, a spoiler in front of it and a slat at the leading edge outboard of the kink; the leading and trailing edge points of the inner and outer border of the flap are marked

controlSurfaceSections.alt: Sections at the inner borders of three control surfaces: (a) a flap whose rounded leading edge passes through the nose point at relHeightLE 0.5 and meets the skin at xsiUpperSkin 0.9 and xsiLowerSkin 0.7 of the flap chord from its trailing edge; (b) a slat whose hollow rear side runs from xsiTEUpper 0.15 over the point at xsiTE 0.04 and relHeightTE 0.45 to xsiTELower 0.12; (c) a spoiler between xsiLE 0.55 and xsiTE 0.69 with the lowest point of its leading edge at relHeightLE 0.8

eq_controlSurfaceDeflection.alt: p' = m' - L/2 e' + R_e'(alpha) R_(e to e') (p - P_inner)

eq_vesselTorisphericalDome.alt: h = R1 - sqrt((R1 - R2)^2 - c^2), with c = R - R2 and sin(alpha) = c/(R1 - R2)

fuelTankVessels.alt: Two side views of a fuselage with fuel tanks: (a) the whole fuselage with the forward tank, the belly tank of two small cylinders and the rear tank, and the translation of the rear tank measured from the origin of the fuselage; (b) the rear tank enlarged, with the pressure vessel inside the vacuum jacket, the origin of the tank at the apex of the forward dome of the outer vessel and the origin of the inner vessel a little behind it

componentSegmentEta.alt: Top view of a wing with root, kink and tip element and the mid-chord line through the middle points of their chords, 5.78 m long from the root to the kink and 8.58 m from the kink to the tip, so that the elements lie at eta 0, 0.403 and 1

componentSegmentEtaXsi.alt: Top view of a wing with the lines of constant eta (steps of 0.1) and xsi of its component segment; point A at eta 0.201 on the mid-chord line and point B at eta 0.201, xsi 0.75 below it, which is eta 0.5, xsi 0.75 in segment 1

componentSegments.alt: Top view of a wing with root, kink and tip element and two rows of brackets above it: (a) one component segment from the root to the tip element, (b) component segment 1 from the root to the kink and component segment 2 from the kink to the tip element

cst2D_airfoil.alt: CST profile in normalized coordinates with upper and lower side, sampling positions and trailing edge thickness

cst2D_construction.alt: Class function times shape function yields the upper side of a CST profile

curvePointListXYZ.alt: Fuselage profile with numbered points, kinks at the floor corners and fixed curve parameters; two consecutive profiles connected at equal curve parameters

eq_cst2D_surfaces.alt: Upper side: \zeta_{upper} = C_{upper} S_{upper} + \psi \Delta\zeta_{TE}/2; lower side: \zeta_{lower} = -C_{lower} S_{lower} - \psi \Delta\zeta_{TE}/2

eq_guideCurvePoint.alt: P = P0 + rY (P1 - P0) + s (rX ex + rZ ez), s = (1 - rY) s0 + rY s1, ez = ex x (P1 - P0) / |ex x (P1 - P0)|

eq_nacaProfile4Digit.alt: NACA 4-digit series: thickness distribution z_t with coefficient a_4, camber line z_c and upper and lower side perpendicular to the camber line

eq_positioningVector.alt: v = L (sin phi, cos phi cos nu, cos phi sin nu)

eq_segmentEtaXsi.alt: P(eta, xsi) = (1 - eta) [(1 - xsi) P_LE,from + xsi P_TE,from] + eta [(1 - xsi) P_LE,to + xsi P_TE,to]

eq_superEllipseProfile.alt: |2y|^m_upper + |(z - z0)/(0.5 - z0)|^n_upper = 1 for z >= z0; |2y|^m_lower + |(z - z0)/(0.5 + z0)|^n_lower = 1 for z < z0; z0 = lowerHeightFraction - 0.5

eq_transformationParent.alt: P = o_parent + t + R_x(phi_x) R_y(phi_y) R_z(phi_z) S p

eq_transformationPoint.alt: P = t + R_x(phi_x) R_y(phi_y) R_z(phi_z) S p

guideCurveCircumference.alt: Relative circumference on a wing profile from -1 over 0 at the leading edge to 1, and on full and half fuselage profiles from 0 at the highest point over the right side

guideCurveCoordinates.alt: Construction of a guide curve point P from the start point P0, the end point P1 and the relative coordinates rX, rY and rZ on a wing segment and on a fuselage segment

guideCurveProfile.alt: Guide curve profile with three points plotted as rX over rY between the implied start and end point, and the resulting top guide curve of a fuselage segment whose points are lifted by rX times the local height

guideCurveSegments.alt: Planform of a wing with three sections: the leading edge guide curve is smooth over the kink section, the trailing edge guide curve with continuity C0 has a kink there

nacaProfile.alt: NACA 2412 with chord, camber line, maximum camber m at position p and thickness t; trailing edge of NACA 0012 without, with zero and with given trailing edge thickness

positioningVector.alt: Construction of a positioning vector of length L from the y-axis rotated by the sweep angle phi about the z-axis and by the dihedral angle nu about the x-axis, and a chain of positionings A, B, C in which positioning C starts at the end of positioning B although section B is additionally translated

powerBreakdownSankey.alt: Sankey diagram of the electric and mechanical power flows at take-off of a fuel cell propulsion unit: the fuel cell stack (370 kW) and the battery (147 kW) feed the power management unit, which passes 434 kW to the inverter, 58 kW to the compressor and 20 kW to the electrical power supply (ata24); the inverter feeds the motor with 425 kW, the motor the gearbox with 408 kW and the gearbox the propeller with 400 kW. The losses of the power management unit, the inverter, the motor and the gearbox (5.2, 8.7, 17.0 and 8.2 kW) branch off as gray bands

profileGeometry2D.alt: Closed NACA 4412 profile with 13 points running clockwise from the trailing edge along the lower side to the leading edge and back, with the relative coordinate zeta from -1 to +1, and a curve through 7 points from its first to its last point

profileGeometry2DNacelle.alt: Side view of a nacelle with the profiles of the sections at 0 and 180 degrees: x of the profile along the nacelle axis, y radially outwards, the lower side facing the axis

profilePointOrder.alt: Point order of a wing profile from the trailing edge along the lower side, and of a fuselage profile from the highest point over the positive y side

rectangleProfile.alt: Rectangle profile with width 1, height heightToWidthRatio and corner radius; largest corner radius of half the height

ribRotation.alt: Oblique view of a patch of the chord surface with one rib: (a) the angle z of 90 degrees between the rear spar as reference line and the rib, measured in the chord surface; (b) the angle x of 65 degrees between the chord surface and the plane of the rib, measured about the line along which the rib meets the surface

segmentEtaXsi.alt: Top view of a wing with two segments, each with its own lines of constant eta and xsi in steps of 0.25, eta running along each segment from its start element and xsi from the leading to the trailing edge, and the point eta 0.5, xsi 0.75 in segment 1

sparCrossSection.alt: Two panels: (a) a section through a wing at eta 0.25 with the webs of the front and the rear spar standing perpendicular to the chord surface, each crossing it on the mid line of its spar; (b) the cross section of the rear spar with web1 and web2 inclined by a rotation of 70 degrees against the chord surface and the upper and lower cap on the skins between the two webs

standardProfile.alt: Rectangle and superellipse profile with start at the top, direction over the positive y side and curve parameters 0, 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75

structuralProfile.alt: T-stringer profile with points P1 to P4 in the x-y plane and three sheets starting at P1, and the coordinate system of each sheet with y along the sheet, z normal to it in the profile plane and x out of the plane

structuralProfileSheet.alt: T-stringer profile extended along its z-axis; on the web the sheet axes x, y and z and the orthotropy direction rotated from x towards y by the angle orthotropyDirection

superEllipseProfile.alt: Three superellipse profiles with upper and lower half: pointed top with flat bottom, circle and diamond

systemArchitectureGraph.alt: Graph of the system architecture of a fuel cell propulsion unit. Electric connections lead from the fuel cell stack and the battery to the power management unit, from there to the compressor, the inverter and the electrical power supply (ata24), and from the inverter to the motor; mechanical connections lead from the motor to the gearbox and on to the propeller; fluid connections lead from the fuel system (ata28) and, through the compressor, from the ambient to the fuel cell stack; two connections without connectionType take the heat from the fuel cell stack through the heat exchanger to the ambient. The connection from the battery carries a control device

systemElementCuboid.alt: Cuboid with a smaller upper face: (a) oblique view with the origin at a corner of the lower face and lengthX, depthY and heightZ; (b) top view with the lower face and, inside it, the upper face, whose upperFaceXmin, upperFaceXmax, upperFaceYmin and upperFaceYmax are measured from the axes through the origin

systemElementCylinderCone.alt: Oblique views of (a) a cylinder with radius and height and (b) a truncated cone with lowerRadius, upperRadius and height; both have their axis along z and the origin at the centre of the lower face

systemElementEllipsoid.alt: Oblique views of an ellipsoid: (a) the semi-axes radiusX, radiusY and radiusZ from the centre along x, y and z; (b) a sector with revolutionAngle 3π/2, which starts at the x-axis and turns about the z-axis towards the y-axis, so that the quarter between the negative y-axis and the positive x-axis is missing

systemElementTorus.alt: Oblique views of a torus about the z-axis: (a) the complete torus; (b) the half with revolutionAngle π on the side of the positive y-axis, with majorRadius from the origin to the centre of the tube and minorRadius on the end face in the x-z plane

systemsLevels.alt: Four boxes for the levels of the system description, each referencing the one before it: the element fuelCellStack in systemElements, the component fuelCellStack_pod1 in genericSystems (systemElementUID), the connection fuelCellFeeder_pod1 in systemArchitectures (componentUID) and a power flow of 370 kW at take-off in powerBreakdowns (connectionUID)

transformationOrder.alt: Side view of an airfoil in three steps: (a) scaled by 3 in x and z, (b) rotated by 12 degrees about the y-axis, (c) translated by the vector t, each step starting from the result of the previous one

transformationRotation.alt: Rotation of a coordinate system in three steps: (a) about the x-axis by phi_x, (b) about the rotated y-axis y' by phi_y, (c) about the twice rotated z-axis z'' by phi_z, each with the axes before the rotation drawn pale, the axis of the rotation drawn dark and the angle shaded with an arrow for its positive sense

uidReferenceSymmetry.alt: Top view of a wing mirrored at the x-z plane with an engine pylon referencing it: with symmetry def the pylon is on the defined side only, with symm on the mirrored side only, with full on both sides

vesselDomeTypes.alt: Meridian sections of the three dome shapes of a vessel, each above the axis of revolution: (a) ellipsoidal domes for halfAxisFraction 0.5, 1 and 1.5, whose height is the cylinder radius times that fraction; (b) a torispherical dome with the spherical dish of radius R1, the knuckle of radius R2, the point where the two meet and the angle alpha under which they meet; (c) an isotensoid dome closed by a flat polar opening whose radius is dimensioned

vesselParameters.alt: Meridian section of a vessel given by design parameters, in two panels: (a) with a cylinder, showing the origin at the apex of the forward dome, the cylinder radius, the cylinder length, the dome height h and the total length as cylinderLength plus twice h, with a pale ellipse for the cross section; (b) with cylinderLength set to zero, where the two domes meet directly

wingCells.alt: Top view of a wing with the two cells of its upper shell: an inner one bounded by the front and the rear spar and by the third and the sixth rib of the inner rib set, and an outer one bounded by relative coordinates, whose borders run at an angle to the lines of constant eta and xsi

wingElementCoordinates.alt: Side view of a section coordinate system and an element coordinate system that is translated and rotated about the y-axis within it; the airfoil, scaled by 3, lies in the element coordinate system, and pale contours at the origin of the section show the airfoil with chord length 1 and scaled by 3 without rotation and translation

wingGeometry.alt: Top and front view of a wing with root, kink and tip section: the positioning of the kink section starts at the root, the positioning of the tip section at the end of the kink positioning; two segments lie between the sections

wingParts.alt: Oblique view of a wing with root, kink and tip section: at each section a coordinate system with the airfoil of its element, positioning arrows from the root to the kink and from the kink to the tip, and two segment surfaces between the airfoils

wingProfileTransformation.alt: Side view of an airfoil with chord length 1, scaled by the element to chord length 5, and rotated about the y-axis by the section

wingRibs.alt: Top view of a wing with two rib sets and a single rib, all running from the front to the rear spar: seven inner ribs in flight direction, a single rib at the kink of the wing between the two spar positions there, and eight outer ribs perpendicular to the rear spar. The rear spar is marked as the reference line of both sets, with a bracket on it for the spacing of 0.8 m between two inner ribs and dots at the start and the end of the outer set

wingSpars.alt: Top view of a wing with three spars on the chord surface of its component segment: a front spar from the root element at xsi 0.15 over the kink element at xsi 0.2 to the tip element at xsi 0.25, a rear spar from the root element at xsi 0.65 over the kink element at xsi 0.66 to the tip element at xsi 0.7, and a short auxiliary spar that starts at the same spar position as the rear spar and ends at eta 0.25 and xsi 0.8. Notes mark the root position of the front spar as eta 0, xsi 0.15 in the component segment and its kink position as eta 1, xsi 0.2 in segment 1, and the position shared by the rear and the auxiliary spar

wingSplitWingtip.alt: Split wingtip: a wing with root and kink section, from whose kink section two segments lead to an upper and a lower tip section

wingStringers.alt: Oblique view of a part of the upper skin of a wing between its leading and its trailing edge, with the traces of the front and the rear spar on it. One stringer, drawn strong, runs through the reference point; the others follow at the pitch from it, which is marked between two of them. All of them are turned by the stringer angle of 8 degrees from the reference direction, the line through the leading edge points of the first and the last element of the component segment

wingStructureSection.alt: Section through a wing between its front and rear spar: the skin of the upper and the lower shell, the filling between the two shells, and the opening that a cut-out leaves in the lower shell between the relative chordwise positions 0.4 and 0.55
